result.title: Dependence-Aware Risk Assessment and Optimal Design of AI-Agent Safeguard Systems
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on safeguards to prevent unauthorized actions while preserving legitimate service. However, existing risk assessments often focus on individual safeguard performance while overlooking dependence among safeguard decisions. This paper develops a dependence-aware framework for risk assessment and optimal design of multi-component AI safeguard systems, jointly selecting configurations and operating policies for sequential layered screening and selective verification. We establish stochastic comparisons of layered-screening error probabilities and invocation costs under lower-orthant ordering. For selective verification, we characterize exactly which policies have error probabilities and review costs that respond monotonically to stronger dependence under supermodular ordering. For a fixed first stage and reviewer, we show that the optimal routing map is a two-threshold rule in the first-stage likelihood ratio. An accompanying open-source software package, Dependence-Aware Policy Optimization Algorithms (DAPOA), facilitates the practical implementation of the proposed framework. Numerical experiments show that ignoring dependence can lead to inaccurate risk assessments and infeasible safeguard designs, with independence-based selections violating security requirements in six of eight scenarios. An empirical study using four LLM safeguards on benchmark-derived agent actions further demonstrates the practical implications of dependence modeling. Under the principal operating setting, dependence-aware selection lowers held-out total cost by 39.6% relative to independence-based selection.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出考虑组件间依赖性的 AI agent 多层防护风险评估与设计框架，分析分层筛选的错误率与调用成本随依赖序的变化，并证明选择性验证的最优路由为基于首阶段似然比的双阈值规则，附开源 DAPOA 软件与实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其级联筛选与选择性验证中的阈值路由、错误率—审查成本权衡及依赖建模，可能为 LVR 的多阶段证据获取、THINK/LOOK/STOP 预算与验证调用策略提供可核查的方法线索，但原文不涉及视觉 latent 状态。
